_provenance: NACH e-mandate rejection reason codes. Structure and the AP6x/AP70 examples follow NPCI circular NPCI/2024-25/NACH/006 (27 Nov 2024, effective 1 Jan 2025), which added 20 codes, revised 33 descriptions and removed 22, as summarised by taxguru. Codes marked source=illustrative are plausible execution-failure reasons used by the simulator and are NOT transcribed from the circular.
_why_this_file_matters: The taxonomy MOVED in Jan 2025 and will move again. A hardcoded reason->action mapping goes stale by design; this is the core argument for adjudication over a lookup table.
